stemMd: A number increased by its half equals 21. What is the number?
explanationMd: Let the number be x. Then x + x/2 = 21, so 3x/2 = 21 and x = 14. Its half is seven, and 14 + 7 checks the total.

distractorRationale.b: This takes half of twenty-one without setting up the full sum.
distractorRationale.a: This is the half-part rather than the whole number.
distractorRationale.d: This increases twenty-one instead of reversing the relation.
distractorRationale.e: This doubles the total rather than dividing by one and a half.
